title: Persona-scoped global iQube projection through Threshold MCP
body: Implemented the canonical persona-scoped iQube projection. OAuth/crossing scope permits projection use only; the Persona Spine, live constitutional agreement, delegated actor binding, global iQube Registry, ownership/edition state, and access engine decide each resource. ArkAgent and Aigent Z are the first same-auth-profile isolation pair. Registry-mapped manifests and ContentQube extracted text are implemented; remaining native adapters, binary/decrypted delivery, fresh crossings, deployment, and live two-persona rehearsal remain.

metadata.tests_run: TypeScript passed in GitHub Actions; 4/4 Threshold persona iQube projection tests passed; 2/2 ContentQube edition ownership tests passed. Full suite remains red on 79 pre-existing failures across 20 unrelated files.
next_steps: Merge PR 108 after review of the known red integration baseline.
Deploy dev and create fresh persona-bound crossings because existing bearers do not contain iqube.read.
Run ArkAgent first, then Aigent Z, and prove the gated Venture Lab edition is visible only to Aigent Z.
Register/backfill unmapped Locker and RoomQube assets and add their canonical rendition adapters.
Add secure binary/decrypted delivery providers without exposing storage URLs or keys.
Keep Root DID aggregation disabled until it is an explicit, human-authorized mode.
